journey.title: Bottom-up documentation-first proposal
journey.purpose: Bottom-up documentation-first proposal with explicit authority, provenance and evidence boundaries.

steps.intent: Select a bounded observed neighborhood and inspect source provenance.
Optionally inspect intended capability context without requiring it for drafting.
Select repository targets and author actual proposed artifacts without canonical writes.
Resolve findings or retain explicit validation gaps without losing content.
Inspect the immutable proposal revision referenced by the concise plan.

claims.statement: Given a scoped multi-target design, when the author requests review, then the operator can inspect exact proposed artifacts and graph changes rather than reconstruct them from plan prose.
claims.rationale: Documentation-first target; runtime bindings and evidence remain to be implemented and qualified.
